verdict.rationale: Neon's branching model gives AI-native users an isolated sandbox: documented Copilot agents run migrations and query optimizations on temporary branches, "keeping production untouched" until changes are validated. Each branch also gets its own isolated auth environment for CI and preview testing, and neon.ts supports auto-expiring branch TTLs. A production user independently confirms branching off main to test and then resetting the branch, and the MCP server's read-only mode was verified live by probe. Missing for 10: the core branching docs appear only as a title in the pack, and no hands-on probe actually created a branch and confirmed data isolation from production.
